name: Bibliography & Citation - PubMed
description: Provides PubMed import and lookup functionality.
project_description: Bibliography & Citation - PubMed adds a PubMed/NCBI E-utilities import and lookup format to the Bibliography & Citation (bibcite) suite. It registers a 'pubmed' serializer format (XML) and a 'pubmed_id' format (newline-separated PMIDs), a PubmedClient service that fetches article metadata from the NCBI efetch endpoint, and an admin lookup form that populates a new reference from a single PubMed ID. Imported PubMed XML is decoded and denormalized into bibcite_entity Reference entities using a configurable field/type mapping.
